title: Chapter 445 Public Anger
content:
Chapter 445 Public Anger

It was precisely because of the actions of the five most powerful empires in the current world that the situation in the entire world was completely disrupted.

It is said that there are more than 200 people in the eighth-level heavenly alliances in the world, but in fact, many people have only one name, and they don't care much.

The celestial beings who can really take care of mundane things are only people in their early hundred years.

And there are only a hundred people in this area, there are about 20 people belonging to the five empires, which is already 1/5 of the number, not to mention that the eighth-level angels of the five empires are all strong within the same level, and their strength is far away. It is not comparable to other ordinary eighth steps.

The five great empires alone are equivalent to a quarter of the strength of these more than a hundred people, which can be called terrifying.

Moreover, even these eighth-rank gods who care about worldly things are not all of one mind, and there are all kinds of conflicts and entanglements of interests with each other, so it is extremely difficult to truly unite together.

In addition, many of these people have the same thoughts as the five great empires, taking the opportunity to annex the weaker empires around them, so as to develop and strengthen themselves.

After this, the so-called eighth-level alliance of immortals has become empty talk, and the veil originally used to cover up the ugliness was also torn off by the five empires and fell into the dust.

But in the end, after the mask used to hide the ugliness is gone, the next thing that countries face and carry out is endless annexation and war.

After the Great Tang Empire in the south annexed several surrounding countries one after another, its strength became even more difficult to contain, forcing the surrounding countries such as Han and Wei to unite and rely on the strength of eight countries to barely contain it.

In the past two years, as the Tang Empire digested the previously annexed territory, its strength became stronger and stronger, and it set its sights on the two countries of Korea and Wei to the north.

As soon as the news spread, the two countries of Han and Wei were shocked.

The strength of the Tang Empire cannot be stopped by these two small empires. They must find reinforcements.

In the past several expansions of the Tang Empire, Han Wei and the other six surrounding countries joined hands to resist the aggression of the Tang Empire.

Although the tendency of the Tang Empire to seize is still difficult to curb, it is undeniable that the combined effect of these empires is still great. At least these eight countries were not wiped out without any reaction like those countries annexed by the Tang Empire before.

The eight empires united together are powerful. Although it is still difficult to defeat the Tang Empire and their strength gradually weakens, they are still tenacious to survive until now.

If the Tang Empire wanted to attack Korea and Wei, or even destroy the lands of these two countries, it had to defeat the Allied Forces of the Eight Kingdoms first.

The cloudy war centered on the Tang Empire and radiated towards the eight surrounding countries. Everyone felt that an extremely large-scale war was coming.

Soon after, Datang's 5 million shence troops went northward, and at the same time they swore to crusade against Korea and Wei, and issued a call to enumerate the sins of the two countries to show justice on their side.

Not long after the Tang Dynasty left the army, the eight surrounding countries met in Daliang, the capital of Wei State, and announced that they would join forces to fight against the tyranny of the Tang Empire.

Tens of millions of troops began to gather under the mobilization of the eight countries, and divided into four groups, each attacking the Tang Empire.

A tragic war broke out quickly. Although the strength of the Eight Kingdoms was twice that of the Tang Empire, the mighty Tang Army was still not something that the Eight Kingdoms could resist.

Three months after the Tang Empire dispatched troops, Han and Wei had lost territory in three entire provinces, losing millions of troops, and the morale of the rest of the army was seriously frustrated. Time to lose again.

And the war in the other three directions is not optimistic.

Although the armies in these three directions effectively delayed the entire 3 million troops of the Tang Empire, none of them could achieve victory, not even a slight victory.

The armies of all countries can only rely on the superiority of numbers to drag the Tang Empire tightly, and rely on countless human lives to fill the consumption of war.

In addition to these, what is even more shocking is that on the frontal battlefields between Korea and Wei, several battles at the level of eighth-order angels broke out.

The battle momentum of these heavenly immortals has spread hundreds of miles around, causing unimaginable damage, and it has brought about subversive changes to the entire battle situation.

This incident started too because the South Korean army was defeated by the Tang Empire, and the remaining 1.5 million troops beheaded more than 800,000 people, and most of the remaining troops were also defeated. Only a mere 300,000 troops retreated to the capital Xinzheng, relying on the strong formation of the capital to resist the oncoming million Tang troops.

Facing the crisis of completely destroying the national unification, the founder of the Han Empire, the Taizu, couldn't care less. He directly united with the leaders of the sects in the country, and directly used the means against the sky to wipe out the millions of Tang troops outside the city in one fell swoop. clean.

This shot can be described as stabbing a hornet's nest.

Although the world is in turmoil today, there has never been an eighth-rank celestial being directly attacking those mortal troops, and the attack was so vicious that it wiped out millions of elites of the Tang Empire at once, and completely wiped out the matter.

After the news spread, the world was shaken, and everyone condemned the actions of the founder of the Han Empire.

The existence of nuclear weapons like the eighth-rank Celestial Immortal was originally only used as a deterrent, but in fact, it would not even make a move at all, and could not make a move.

Like the five great empires that just started the world of great controversy, although they are powerful and each have several eighth-ranks, their journey of conquest and annexation is carried out by relying on soldiers below the seventh rank. Pass the eighth-level shot in their hands.

Even if the empire created by the eighth-rank was able to be wiped out, the eighth-rank celestial being would just leave his homeland, hide his name, and no longer pay attention to mundane things.

Even in the previous struggles between the monster race and the human race, there were mostly six or seven ranks as the coaches and brains, each leading tens of thousands and hundreds of thousands of existences above the eighth rank, and no one had ever seen anyone make a move.

Now that the Han Empire dared to break this iron law, the two races of humans and monsters have abided by the rules for thousands of years. It is really against the world, and it is even more outrageous than what the five empires did before.

After all, even if the five empires annexed other empires, it would not do much damage to the overall strength of the human race.

Even because of the unity of power, following an order together, the potential and energy that can be exerted are stronger than the previous loose state, which is not bad for the human race as a whole.

But if Tier 8 goes off in person, with the power of each of them equivalent to a nuclear bomb, they can easily wipe out hundreds of thousands of troops with a single shot, let alone killing millions.

If both sides continue to do this, then the entire human race does not need to be destroyed by the monster race. It only needs the two sides to kill each other's forces fiercely, and the human race can basically be declared extinct.
